name: vibeset
description: Agent skills from Vibeset: instructions you hand your coding agent once and it knows for good.

plugins.name: finito
plugins.description: Closes a working session with a summary you can read, a handoff block for compacting now and a resume block for coming back another day.

plugins.name: diretto
plugins.description: Forces the agent to answer in numbered steps you can execute, with the exact command inside each step and no filler.

plugins.name: smart-defaults
plugins.description: Makes a website start in the visitor's own theme and language, with no flash and no forced redirects.

plugins.name: spanish-cave-man
plugins.description: Caveman-style token efficiency, spoken with a real Spanish regional accent: eleven dialects, two intensity levels.

plugins.name: siteindex
plugins.description: Leaves a website ready to be found: robots.txt, sitemap, canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD and the AI-crawler decision, ending in a measurement.

plugins.name: galsas
plugins.description: Audits a repository for legal exposure (AI Act marking, dependency licences, GDPR and cookies, EU consumer sales) and writes a LEGAL.md with the fix for each finding.
